default._resident_note: 421,224 → 422,080 B (+856) and flash 1,185,668 → 1,190,108 for the route-corridor POI snapshot (#948, epic #946). Figures are **CI's** (the `embedded` job is the gate and runs floating stable); the pinned local host links 8 B less resident, the usual layout difference, and a different flash figure — neither is gated. The whole increase is **one named allocation**: `app` 135,224 → 136,080 B (+856), i.e. `size_of::<App>()`. Nothing else moved — the delta and the `app` delta are the same 856 bytes. It is the new `UiRuntime::corridor_scratch` (`CorridorScratch`): a 16-slot `heapless::Vec<CorridorPoi>` (16 × 52 B = 832) plus its `want`/`taken_for` snapshot keys. Held once in `App` **by design**, exactly like `poi_scratch` before it — inline in the `Screen` union it would multiply across all 10 stack slots (~8.6 KB) instead of costing the buffer once (issue #425). Poll frame unmoved at 9,728 B.

floating_stable_observation._comment: Hand-recorded snapshot of what CI's floating-stable toolchain links; nothing regenerates it. SUPERSEDED as of #927: the profile figures above are now taken from CI directly (run 30306462532), so this block no longer carries the only CI datapoint. Kept for the trend it records — CI at 5eb3e72e linked 421,128, at 9bb7adf8 421,176, and with #927 421,224 — and for the point it was written to make: floating stable links the same resident set and the same poll frame as the pinned toolchain, differing only in flash.
